'''Arrow''' was a bay mare owned by [[Moiraine Damodred]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Arrow}}

==Appearance==
Arrow is a bay mare.

==History==
Moiraine purchased Arrow when she made it to [[Accepted]] status in the [[White Tower]]. {{Ref/book|0|4}} Moiraine always rides a small [[horse]] as tall horses make her look like a child. Arrow was fast and has great endurance. The mare was even able to jump fences.

Arrow was ridden by Moiraine while she travels to [[Chachin]].{{Ref/book|0|21}} A woman attempted to steal Arrow while it was stationed outside of [[The Ruffled Goose]].{{Ref/book|0|23}}
